code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    candidates=[]
    for i,row in enumerate(grid):
        if i and i<h-1 and len(set(row))==1:
            candidates.append(('r',i,row[0]))
    for j in range(w):
        vals=[grid[i][j] for i in range(h)]
        if j and j<w-1 and len(set(vals))==1:
            candidates.append(('c',j,vals[0]))
    axis,k,_=candidates[0]
    if axis=='r':
        a,b=grid[:k],grid[k+1:]
    else:
        a=[row[:k] for row in grid]; b=[row[k+1:] for row in grid]
    common=set(v for row in a for v in row)&set(v for row in b for v in row)
    base=next(iter(common))
    return [[3 if a[i][j]==b[i][j] else base for j in range(len(a[0]))] for i in range(len(a))]
'''
